data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate released GBP 9.5 million in prior year reserves, representing a 24.06% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by favorable claims development, particularly low loss experience for the 2012 underwriting year and prior. Specific events contributing to the release include the settlement of a 2013 medical isotope plant loss in South Africa for less than initially reserved, and a reduction in the sterling value of a claim for the Hamaoka nuclear plant incident (related to the 2011 Japan earthquake) due to favorable currency movements.
